new_this_month.title: Mapping the biological effects of micro- and nanoplastics in mammalian intestinal models: a scoping review.
new_this_month.summary: Scoping review mapping the biological effects of micro and nanoplastics across mammalian intestinal models.

new_this_month.title: Exposure to polyethylene terephthalate nanoplastics elicits renal injury with limited compensation and associated intestinal alterations: A time-resolved multi-omics study.
new_this_month.summary: Fourteen days of oral PET nanoplastics caused time resolved renal injury in mice with intestinal alterations, constrained by antioxidant compensation.

new_this_month.title: The combined toxicity of polystyrene microplastics and glyphosate on Daphnia magna: Physiological and behavioral responses.
new_this_month.journal: Comp Biochem Physiol C Toxicol Pharmacol
new_this_month.summary: Polystyrene microplastics with glyphosate produced physiological and behavioural toxicity in Daphnia magna.

new_this_month.title: Chronic Polystyrene Microplastic Exposure Worsens Cognitive Dysfunction and Alzheimer's Disease-like Neuropathology in APP/PS1 Mice.
new_this_month.summary: Six months of 1 micrometre polystyrene microplastics worsened cognitive dysfunction and Alzheimer's-like neuropathology in APP/PS1 mice.

new_this_month.title: Micro- and nanoplastics in gastric cancer: A narrative review.
new_this_month.summary: Narrative review of micro and nanoplastics in gastric cancer, covering mechanisms, H. pylori interaction and experimental evidence.

new_this_month.title: Quercetin attenuates polystyrene nanoplastic-induced intestinal barrier injury through modulation of macrophage inflammatory responses.
new_this_month.summary: Quercetin attenuated polystyrene nanoplastic-induced intestinal barrier injury in mice through modulation of macrophage inflammatory responses.

new_this_month.title: Surface Chemistry Shapes Nanoplastic Mixture Responses in Developing Amniote Embryos.
new_this_month.summary: Surface chemistry shaped nanoplastic mixture responses in developing amniote embryos, with oppositely charged particles altering brain gene and protein covariance.

new_this_month.title: 14C-Enabled Quantitative Fate Mapping of Orally Administered Polystyrene Nanoplastics in Laying Hens.
new_this_month.summary: Quantitative fate mapping showed orally administered polystyrene nanoplastics distributed across laying hens' tissues and retained in eggs.

new_this_month.title: Microplastics and the Kidney: A Narrative Review of Human Evidence, Molecular Mechanisms of Cell Injury, and Future Directions.
new_this_month.summary: Narrative review of human evidence, molecular mechanisms and future directions for microplastic injury to the kidney.

new_this_month.title: Polymer-specific nanoplastic exposure, mitochondrial dysfunction, and depressed ejection fraction in humans.
new_this_month.summary: Blood levels of polystyrene and polyethylene were associated with lower left ventricular ejection fraction in older adults, with polymer-specific mitochondrial dysfunction in human cells.

new_this_month.title: Vickeline NambaBisfenol A, bisfenol F e DEHP remodel the transcriptome of a human 3D placenta model.
new_this_month.summary: Bisphenols A and F and DEHP remodelled the transcriptome of a human 3D placental model at low concentrations.

new_this_month.title: Microplastic-Induced Female Reproductive Toxicity: Mechanisms and Potential Protective Interventions.
new_this_month.summary: Review of microplastic mechanisms for female reproductive toxicity and candidate protective interventions.

new_this_month.title: Do nanoplastics reshape microglial support of neuronal resilience? A study of microglial bioenergetics and microglia-neuron communication in vitro.
new_this_month.summary: Nanoplastic exposure reshaped microglial support of neuronal resilience in vitro through nuclear factor erythroid 2-like 2 pathway.

new_this_month.title: Size-Associated Partitioning of Oral Polystyrene Particles Between Intestinal Capillaries and Lacteals Determines Systemic and Lymph Node Distribution in Mice.
new_this_month.summary: Polystyrene particles of different sizes partitioned between intestinal capillaries and lacteals, with larger particles reaching mesenteric lymph nodes and inflamed nodes.

new_this_month.title: Navigating the Nonylphenol Hazard: Insights into Toxicity Mechanisms and Mitigation Approaches.
new_this_month.summary: Review of nonylphenol toxicity mechanisms and mitigation approaches, covering endocrine disruption across multiple organ systems.

new_this_month.title: Effects of Photoaged Polyethylene Microplastics on Cardiac Injury and Fibrosis-like Remodeling in Zebrafish.
new_this_month.summary: Photoaged polyethylene microplastics injured the zebrafish heart and drove fibrosis-like remodelling, a modification confirmed in pristine particles.

new_this_month.title: Ferro-Immuno-Structural Axis (FISA): Kidney specific microplastic toxicity via TLR18 centric immunosuppression and iron dyshomeostasis in rainbow trout.
new_this_month.journal: Comp Biochem Physiol Part D Genomics Proteomics
new_this_month.summary: Microplastic exposure produced kidney-specific toxicity in rainbow trout through toll-like receptor centred immunosuppression and iron dyshomeostasis.

new_this_month.title: Tissue-specific microplastic burdens in humans: An intra-individual mapping of 18 tissue types.
new_this_month.summary: First intra-individual mapping of 18 human tissue types documented tissue-specific microplastic burdens across ten donors.

new_this_month.title: Undiseased and diseased abdominal aortas contain environmentally relevant micronanoplastics.
new_this_month.summary: Environmentally relevant micro and nanoplastics were detected in undiseased and diseased abdominal aortas, adding to evidence they accumulate in atherosclerotic lesions.

new_this_month.title: Sputum microplastic concentrations and their association with underweight in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: first human evidence combined with integrated network toxicology analysis.
new_this_month.summary: Pyrolysis gas chromatography mass spectrometry measured 13 polymer types in sputum of 40 COPD patients, with PVC associated underweight and lower fat mass.

new_this_month.title: Study on the promoting effect of microplastic exposure on prostate cancer migration and invasion based on network toxicology and single-cell sequencing technology.
new_this_month.summary: Network toxicology with single-cell sequencing examined how microplastic-associated acetyl tributyl citrate exposure promotes prostate cancer migration and invasion.

new_this_month.title: Curcumin carried by polystyrene nanoparticles inhibits phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signaling pathway through miR-186 and down-regulates Twist to inhibit the epithelial-mesenchymal transition in colorectal cancer in mice.
new_this_month.summary: Curcumin carried by polystyrene nanoparticles inhibited phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase and Twist in colorectal cancer mice through a microRNA mechanism.

new_this_month.title: Ocular health risks posed by micro‑ and nano-plastics: A review.
new_this_month.summary: Review of micro and nanoplastic risks to ocular health, covering detection in human tissues, animal models and cells.

new_this_month.title: Combined toxic effects of polyethylene microplastics (PE-MPs) and 4-nonylphenol on the common carp (Cyprinus carpio) juvenile: multi-biomarker approach.
new_this_month.summary: Polyethylene microplastics with 4-nonylphenol produced combined biomarker changes in juvenile common carp.

new_this_month.title: A framework for assessing human internal microplastic exposure through dataset alignment and quality screening.
new_this_month.summary: A framework for estimating internal human microplastic exposure from external intake estimates and biodistribution modelling; a method paper.

new_this_month.title: Natural products as protective modulators of environmental pollutant toxicity through the gut-X axis.
new_this_month.summary: Review of natural products as protective modulators of environmental pollutant toxicity, with micro and nanoplastics covered.

new_this_month.title: The interplay between microplastics and respiratory viral diseases.
new_this_month.summary: Review of the interplay between microplastics and respiratory viral diseases, including coronavirus and influenza.

new_this_month.title: Toxicological Effects of Polyethylene Terephthalate Microplastics on Chronic Kidney Disease: An Integrative Bioinformatics, Network Toxicology, and Machine Learning Study.
new_this_month.summary: Integrative bioinformatics, network toxicology and machine learning examined how PET microplastics may affect chronic kidney disease.

new_this_month.title: Dietary components regulate the gastrointestinal fate of polystyrene nanoplastics through differential aggregation, mucus transport and Caco-2 cell interactions.
new_this_month.summary: Casein, cellulose and ghee altered polystyrene nanoplastic aggregation and mucus transport, affecting Caco-2 cell interaction.

new_this_month.title: Polyethylene nanoplastics promote tumor progression in canine mammary tumor U27 cells via the PPARγ-NF-κB axis.
new_this_month.summary: Polyethylene nanoplastics promoted canine mammary tumour cell progression through the PPAR-gamma NF-kappaB axis.

new_this_month.title: Interpreting the Microplastics Intake-Detection Gap in Human Biomonitoring.
new_this_month.summary: Review of the microplastics intake detection gap in human biomonitoring and the need for size-resolved methodological harmonisation.

new_this_month.title: Polystyrene Microplastics Exacerbate Arsenic-Induced Ferroptosis and Lipid Metabolism Dysregulation in Chicken Hepatocytes through SIRT7-SIRT1 Axis-Associated Transcriptomic Alterations.
new_this_month.summary: Polystyrene microplastics worsened arsenic-induced ferroptosis and lipid metabolism disorder in chicken hepatocytes through a SIRT7-SIRT1 axis.

new_this_month.title: Prepregnancy Exposure to High Doses of Nanoplastics Triggers Persistent Vaginal Microbiome Dysbiosis to Induce Adverse Pregnant Outcomes.
new_this_month.summary: High doses of aged polystyrene nanoparticles in pregnant mice produced persistent vaginal dysbiosis and adverse pregnancy outcomes.

new_this_month.title: Oral Exposure to Polystyrene Nanoplastics Disrupts Gut-Testis Metabolic Homeostasis and EGR1-Associated Steroidogenic Regulation in Male Mice.
new_this_month.summary: Oral polystyrene nanoplastics disrupted gut-testis metabolic homeostasis in male mice through EGR1 and steroidogenic regulation.

new_this_month.title: Polystyrene Nanoplastics Disrupt Lateral Line Neuromasts and Impair Flow-Guided Behaviors in Zebrafish.
new_this_month.summary: Polystyrene nanoplastics disrupted zebrafish later line neuromasts and impaired flow-guided behaviour under vortex-flow conditions.

new_this_month.title: How a Single-Chain Polystyrene Nanoparticle Dictates α-Synuclein Adsorption and Intramolecular β-Sheet Nucleation.
new_this_month.summary: Metadynamics simulations showed a single-chain polystyrene nanoparticle dictates how much alpha-synuclein it adsorbs and nucleates intramolecular beta-strand folding.
